description:
The human's own cart, READ-ONLY (PR-4, safe scope buyer_cart_read; OAuth grant): product, variant, quantity, current unit price (INTEGER base-units, exp 6), store, and whether each line can still be ordered.

- You cannot add, change, remove or check out — that stays with the human at webaz.xyz.
- unavailable_reason uses the ORDER-CREATION gates; never draft an unorderable line, say why.
- To buy: webaz_quote_order (binding price) → webaz_order_draft → webaz_submit_order_request, one variant per order, each approved by the human; ordered lines leave the cart.
name: webaz_cart_view
